1---
2name: polymarket-data-api
3description: Access Polymarket user trading data and portfolio analytics. Get trader positions, P&L, trading history, portfolio value, leaderboards, and top holders. Use when users ask about user portfolios, trading history, P&L tracking, leaderboards, position holders, or user activity. NOT for market discovery, prices, or searching markets (use polymarket skill instead). Base URL: https://data-api.polymarket.com
4---
5
6Polymarket Data API Quick Reference
7
8⚠️ IMPORTANT: Checking Trader Profitability
9
10When asked if a trader is profitable, DO NOT only show winning positions. Always check:
11
121. Use leaderboard API first (most accurate):
13   /v1/leaderboard?userName={username}&orderBy=PNL&timePeriod=DAY
14   Check `pnl` field: `> 0` = profitable, `< 0` = losing
15
162. For detailed analysis, calculate total P&L:
17   - Get closed positions: `/closed-positions?user=0x...` (won/lost bets)
18   - Get open positions: `/positions?user=0x...&redeemable=false` (unrealized P&L)
19   - Total P&L = Realized + Unrealized
20
213. Check BOTH wins AND losses:
22   wins = [p for p in closed_positions if p['realizedPnl'] > 0]
23   losses = [p for p in closed_positions if p['realizedPnl'] < 0]
24   net_pnl = sum(p['realizedPnl'] for p in closed_positions)
25
26❌ WRONG: Only showing top 10 wins (cherry-picking data)  
27✅ CORRECT: Show wins, losses, and net P&L
28
29Base URL
30
31https://data-api.polymarket.com

59Address Format (CRITICAL)
60
61Wallet addresses MUST be lowercase, 0x-prefixed, exactly 42 characters:
62
63Format address correctly
64def format_address(address):
65    """Ensure address is lowercase, 0x-prefixed, 42 chars"""
66    clean = address.lower().replace('0x', '')
67    if len(clean) != 40:
68        raise ValueError(f"Invalid address length: {len(clean)} (expected 40)")
69    if not all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in clean):
70        raise ValueError("Invalid hex characters in address")
71    return f"0x{clean}"
72
73Example usage
74address = "0xABC123..."  # ❌ Wrong (uppercase)
75address = format_address(address)  # ✓ Correct: "0xabc123..."
76
77Condition IDs must be 66 characters (0x + 64 hex). Same formatting rules apply.
78
79Making API Calls
80
81Use the `requests` library with properly formatted addresses:
82
83import requests
84
85Format the address first
86user_address = format_address("0x56687BF447Db6fFa42fFe2204a05EdAA20f55839")
87
88Get user's current positions
89response = requests.get(
90    "https://data-api.polymarket.com/positions",
91    params={"user": user_address, "limit": 20}
92)
93positions = response.json()
94
95Get portfolio value
96value_response = requests.get(
97    "https://data-api.polymarket.com/value",
98    params={"user": user_address}
99)
100portfolio_value = value_response.json()[0]["value"]
101
102Get top finance traders this month
103leaderboard = requests.get(
104    "https://data-api.polymarket.com/v1/leaderboard",
105    params={
106        "category": "FINANCE",
107        "timePeriod": "MONTH",
108        "orderBy": "PNL",
109        "limit": 25
110    }
111).json()

113Common Tasks
114
115| Task | Endpoint |
116|------|----------|
117| Check profitability | `/v1/leaderboard?userName={username}\u0026orderBy=PNL` |
118| Current positions | `/positions?user={address}` |
119| Won/lost bets | `/closed-positions?user={address}` |
120| Trade history | `/trades?user={address}` |
121| User activity | `/activity?user={address}` |
122| Portfolio value | `/value?user={address}` |
123| Markets traded | `/traded?user={address}` |
124| Leaderboard rankings | `/v1/leaderboard?category={category}\u0026timePeriod={period}` |
125| Market holders | `/holders?market={condition_id}` |
126| API health | `/` |
127
128Key Parameters
129
130User Endpoints: `user` (required, 42-char address), `limit`, `offset`, `sortBy` (CURRENT, CASHPNL, PERCENTPNL, TITLE), `sortDirection` (ASC/DESC), `redeemable` (false to exclude finished markets)
131
132Leaderboard: `category` (OVERALL, POLITICS, SPORTS, CRYPTO, CULTURE, FINANCE, TECH, ECONOMICS, WEATHER), `timePeriod` (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, ALL), `orderBy` (PNL, VOL), `limit` (max 50)
133
134Activity: `type` (TRADE, SPLIT, MERGE, REDEEM, REWARD, CONVERSION, MAKER_REBATE), `side` (BUY, SELL), `start`/`end` (Unix timestamps)
135
136See [api.md](references/api.md) for complete parameter documentation.
137
138Error Handling
139
140- 400 Bad Request: Invalid parameters (check address format: 0x + 40 hex chars)
141- 404 Not Found: User has no data or invalid endpoint
142- 500 Server Error: Retry with backoff
143
144Common Issues:
145- Addresses must be 42 chars lowercase (0x + 40 hex)
146- Condition IDs must be 66 chars (0x + 64 hex)
147- Empty results = empty array, not error
148- Category and timePeriod values are UPPERCASE
149- No auth required for all endpoints
150
151Example Workflows
152
153Check if a trader is profitable (RECOMMENDED):
1541. Use leaderboard API: `/v1/leaderboard?userName={username}\u0026orderBy=PNL`
1552. Check `pnl` field: positive = profitable, negative = losing
1563. For details: get closed positions `/closed-positions?user=0x...` and open positions `/positions?user=0x...\u0026redeemable=false`
157
158Analyze a trader's complete performance:
1591. Get leaderboard P\u0026L: `/v1/leaderboard?userName={username}`
1602. Get closed positions (won/lost bets): `/closed-positions?user=0x...\u0026limit=50`
1613. Get open positions (unrealized P\u0026L): `/positions?user=0x...\u0026redeemable=false`
1624. Get trade history: `/trades?user=0x...\u0026limit=100`
1635. Calculate: Total P\u0026L = Realized + Unrealized
164
165Find top traders:
1661. Get leaderboard: `/v1/leaderboard?category=FINANCE\u0026timePeriod=MONTH\u0026orderBy=PNL\u0026limit=25`
1672. Check specific trader: `/positions?user={trader_address}`
168
169Analyze a market's holders:
1701. Get top holders: `/holders?market={condition_id}\u0026limit=10`
1712. Check their positions: `/positions?user={holder_address}`
